scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.lint: npm --workspace apps/web run lint && cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy app
scripts.test: npm --workspace apps/web run test && npm --workspace packages/core run test && cd apps/api && uv run pytest
scripts.test:mobile: npm --prefix apps/mobile ci && npm --prefix apps/mobile run test
